title: Marguerite and the Inheritance
author: Casper Brightwater
blurb: Jonah Galloway, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
